snippet.title: Mike's POV History
snippet.description:
I’ve always been drawn to history. Not just the big events, but the feeling of living through them. The places people walked, the moments they stood in, the ordinary days happening alongside world-changing ones.

Recently, I started using AI as a tool to reconstruct those moments visually. Not to rewrite history or sensationalise it, but to help bridge the gap between then and now — to see the past from ground level, as if you were really there.

This channel is about exploring history through a personal point of view. Reconstructing scenes, environments, and perspectives that help make historical moments feel tangible, human, and easier to connect with.

No gimmicks. Just history, brought a little closer to the present.

snippet.title: EarthquakeSim
snippet.description:
Let's test the whole planet for earthquakes using real seismic data! Featured by BBC, Corridor Crew, Curiosity Channel, Temblor Earth News, BIG Media, and other international media outlets. My channel focuses on realistic 3D earthquake destruction simulations of a variety of structures from around the world. 

My simulations have been enhanced by the voluntary contributions of Victor Vescu - a geophysicist & Ph.D. student at Caltech. He provides invaluable scientific advice and video ideas.

These simulations along with my piano music (Spotify/Youtube: Pardon my Piano) are part of a project called "In Terra Pax" that aims to bring financial and emotional support to earthquake victims around the world.

RE-uploading my content is strictly prohibited under COPYRIGHT laws.

snippet.title: glamourdaze
snippet.description:
Glamourdaze.com brings the past back to life. I take authentic early fragments of silent 16fps footage (not AI generated) and restore them to life by a combination of manual frame-by-frame colorization as well as the use of deep exemplar-based video colorization techniques. I place a particular emphasis on women, their lives, fashion and beauty—details often overlooked by early male filmmakers. The footage is upscaled and the frames interpolated to a higher frame rate (in most cases 60fps) with immersive soundtracks to create a true time travel experience. Glamourdaze is also a vintage fashion and beauty destination, featuring color-restored history and retro tutorials.
All films are licensed, procured by private agreement from relevant copyright holders, or deemed to be public domain.
Where relevant, links are provided to permission granters and to public domain / creative commons archive sources.

Fascinating Horror is all about in-depth research, respectful storytelling, and learning what we can from the mistakes of the past. You might be surprised to discover just how much of today's world is shaped by long-forgotten disasters from decades gone by.

snippet.title: Daily Dose Documentary
snippet.description:
Daily Dose Documentary satiates your thirst for historical understanding, life-long learning and a clear conveyance of the truth. It's the decades-long passion project of lead documentary filmmaker, voice actor and author Tom Page. Tom has produced over 1,200 short and long documentaries overwhelmingly about American History, Military History, Biography, and World History. 

Tom has also authored numerous books, including three on under-told stories of American History (Learn more below).

Thank you for watching and learning from history!

snippet.title: TimeLens
snippet.description:
TimeLens brings history into sharp focus—exploring major world events and their direct impact on today’s headlines. Through deep dives, analysis, and gripping storytelling, we uncover how the past shapes politics, culture, and global conflicts right now.

🔍 What We Cover:
✓ Historical Turning Points (Wars, Revolutions, Innovations)
✓ Modern Events Explained Through History
✓ Geopolitical Deep Dives (Past → Present Connections)
✓ Underrated Stories You Won’t Find in Textbooks

📌 New Videos Daily, Weekly—Subscribe to see the world through a clearer lens.

snippet.title: HISTORY
snippet.description: The HISTORY® Channel, a division of A+E Global Media, is the premier destination for historical storytelling. From best-in-class documentary events, to a signature slate of industry leading nonfiction series and premium fact-based scripted programming, The HISTORY® Channel serves as the most trustworthy source of informational entertainment in media. The HISTORY® channel has been named the #1 U.S. TV network in buzz for seven consecutive years by YouGov BrandIndex, and a top favorite TV network by Beta Research Corporation. For a deeper dive, visit history.com or follow @history on Instagram, Twitter, Facebook, and TikTok.
